current_task_binding.dataset_name: FireCCI51: MODIS Fire_cci Burned Area Pixel Product, Version 5.1

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global monthly burned-area observations within the FireCCI51 product footprint.

analytical_capabilities: Map and quantify the spatial distribution of burned areas
Analyze monthly and seasonal patterns of fire occurrence
Detect interannual and long-term variability in burned area
Compare fire activity across locations, ecological zones, or administrative boundaries
Stratify burned pixels using the supplied ESA CCI land-cover class
Evaluate detection confidence and distinguish unobserved or non-burnable pixels

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: BurnDate, the estimated day of year of first burn detection; ConfidenceLevel is expressed as a percentage
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the BurnDate band to identify and time detected burning. ConfidenceLevel ranges from 1 to 100 percent. LandCover contains ESA CCI categorical classes for burned pixels. ObservedFlag uses -1 for pixels not observed during the month and -2 for non-burnable pixels; these values must not be counted as valid unburned observations. No catalog scale factor is specified for these bands.

current_task_binding.data_source: European Space Agency Climate Change Initiative Fire ECV, hosted in Google Earth Engine

observation_identity_contract.physical_object: surface area and timing affected by vegetation fire
observation_identity_contract.source_lineage: ESA CCI FireCCI51 burned-area production lineage derived from MODIS observations
observation_identity_contract.core_measurement_semantics: FireCCI51 burned-area pixel detection and burn timing
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: official mirror, archive, format, reprojection, resampling or temporal aggregation retaining FireCCI51 observations
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: MCD64A1, GFED, active-fire detection or another burned-area algorithm without FireCCI51 input

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: ESA FireCCI MODIS burned-area pixel product version 5.1 distributed by CEDA/Copernicus or hosted in Earth Engine is admitted. C3S burned-area v1.0 may be used as a companion comparison but is not an alias; MODIS MCD64A1, GFED, FireCCILTDR, active-fire detections and other burned-area products are excluded unless FireCCI51 is also operationally processed.

repointed_from.why_former_anchor_was_wrong: The supplied Methods use FireCCI v5.1 and C3S v1.0 as the satellite burned-area records. MCD64A1 is not identified as an operational input.
repointed_from.why_new_anchor: ESA/CCI/FireCCI/5_1 is the exact ready catalog representation of one of the two burned-area products explicitly used in the Methods and is present in the current dataset index.
